glosses: final, finals (game between the last two competitors remaining in the running, in elimination tournaments)
endgame, end game (moment in the game when the threat of checkmate is low and the kings participate in the struggle)

examples.text: La décision finale appartient au président.
examples.en: The final decision rests with the president.

examples.text: Nous lui avons laissé la décision finale.
examples.en: We left the final decision to him.

examples.text: Il est temps de mettre la touche finale.
examples.en: It's time to apply the final touches.

examples.text: Le juge renversa la décision finale.
examples.en: The judge reversed the final decision.

examples.text: Je vais maintenant ajouter la touche finale.
examples.en: Now I'll add the finishing touch.
